fdsa.book: Functional Data Structures and Algorithms: A Proof Assistant Approach

accounting_cut.note: This accounting reads the preserved005/C2 evidence; it does not credit subsequent recovery or the upstream update as validated mathematics.

fdsa.method: Read-only comparison of current STATE, exact historical acceptance/coverage receipts, canonical source-obligation tables, preservation dispositions and current Git tree/ancestry. No compiler or new proof certification. Inventory counts count unique first-column obligation IDs; Chapter1 is unnumbered. Source-obligation units mix definitions, equations, algorithms, claims, exercises, boundaries and correspondence tasks, so their counts are not a weighted book percentage or a theorem count.

limitations: Historical Passed reviews and full audits do not confer acceptance on C2 or the new master integration.
No complete per-obligation classification of every later chapter against the expanded modern conaled library was performed; reuse may exist under other names.
Preserved draft path counts do not imply that each should become a separate public interface.
No restored process/session ID was polled; no setup, compiler, source/index/ref or remote mutation occurred.

counting_rules: Lexical source records and exercise headings are not equal-weight mathematical obligations.
Source reading, formal implementation, historical focused checking, current integration verification and chapter acceptance are distinct.
Related existing library code needs explicit source/specification correspondence before coverage credit.
Frozen older fields can be superseded by later exact-identity evidence without rewriting history.
